elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The clause is triggered only “[u]pon termination of the Agreement” and does not mention expiry.

elements.element: The obligations apply upon termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) expressly applies “[u]pon termination of the Agreement.”
Kubient must, at Customer's request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is available “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Vendor must return all Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must “return to Customer ... all Customer data,” with illustrative categories included.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return “within thirty (30) days” of the termination trigger.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The required format is “a commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Kubient to “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after deleting the Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Kubient must “certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: The fallback obligations apply upon termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The operative heading expressly applies “[u]pon termination of the Agreement.”
Kubient must, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: The transition-assistance window must cover 90 days.
elements.evidence: The clause permits assistance for up to six months, which encompasses the 90-day fallback window.

elements.element: Vendor must export or return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must return to Customer all Customer data in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return within thirty days of termination.

result.reason: The redline satisfies the stated post-termination fallback and nearly all preferred requirements, including six months of assistance, rates, timely machine-readable data return, deletion, and written certification. It does not satisfy the preferred position because the operative trigger covers termination only, not expiry. The changes are confined to relevant exit obligations and do not displace unrelated commercial terms.
